abilities.name: Dae'uhl
abilities.text: When a Friendly Unit receives Damage, reduce the Total Damage by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Mass Recall
abilities.text: Once per Game. Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. All Friendly Protoss Units Within 6″ of this Faction Indicator are removed from the battlefield and returned to Reserves.
